mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees and fair at City Hall.

City news today includes an update on the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, which aims to improve accessibility and will require trail closures near Lincoln and South Franklin Street starting in mid-September. Also, road construction is ongoing along Highway M for the Aldi development.

There is a lot happening today, including the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on September 7, or catch trivia next week at various local spots.
On Friday, September 4, the Verona Police Department made an arrest of a 34-year-old Madison woman regarding the sexual assault of a child by a school staff member for incidents reported in 2019.
Today's delicious flavor is Mint Cookie, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM so make sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
